$comment: THE one config file for Jeebhar. Copy to jeebhar.config.json (git-ignored) and fill in. `npm run build:bluehost` turns it into everything the site needs; nothing else holds settings or secrets.

bluehost.$comment: SSH login from Bluehost → Websites → Settings → SSH Access. Enable SSH there first.

domains.$comment: Every domain serves the same site. Add jeebhar.de and jeebhar.in as alias (parked) domains of jeebhar.com in Bluehost. defaultLanguage picks the first language a new visitor sees; the toggle overrides it.

admin.$comment: Password for the content editor at https://jeebhar.com/#/admin. At least 16 characters. Generate: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(24).toString('hex'))"

mail.$comment: Where contact-form enquiries are emailed. transport 'smtp' is most reliable (Gmail needs an App Password). transport 'mail' uses Bluehost's built-in mailer with no setup — then use a 'from' address on your own domain, e.g. website@jeebhar.com.

dev.$comment: Local development only: `npm run dev` runs the PHP API on this port and Vite proxies /api to it.
